_comment: Human override for a built step's completion/highlight, keyed by guide id -> step id. Value is either "manual" (drop the auto-detected completion + item highlight, so the step is ticked by hand) or an object { "complete": <condition>, "item": <id> } that REPLACES them. Use "manual" when the enricher grounded an incidental/secondary item; use the object form when the correct completion is knowable but the single-item auto-detector can't express it (e.g. own two different items). build_raw_guide.py applies this after building. Ids are stable per raw file; re-verify after a re-scrape.

fresh-off-the-boat-005._note: Buy a bucket AND a spade at the Lumbridge general store; auto-detector only tracked the spade. Complete once you own both. (Bucket=1925, Spade=952.)

making-the-loop-around-f-002c._note: complete on receiving the Research package (id 290), not on Rune Mysteries finishing
